page: Amazon Web Services r9gd.xlarge is a memory-optimized instance based on the AWS Nitro hypervisor and powered by 64-bit Arm architecture AWS Graviton processors. The configuration features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores operating at 3.3 GHz with a single thread per core. Memory capacity totals 32.0 GB, establishing an allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU without hardware GPU acceleration.

The instance includes bundled local storage comprised of a 237 GB direct-attached NVMe SSD instance store volume. This internal NVMe storage provides low-latency disk operations for scratch processing without requiring external network storage for temporary files. Networking is configured with a 2 Gbps baseline bandwidth, and the server includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The arm64 Graviton processor architecture combined with integrated local NVMe storage provides high operational resource efficiency for memory-intensive footprints requiring rapid temporary data transfers.

Workload targets for the r9gd.xlarge include in-memory databases, distributed key-value caches like Redis and Memcached, real-time analytics engines, and data transformation pipelines that require high memory capacity paired with fast local scratch volumes.
